unified_issues.description: The render-harness JucePlugin_ManufacturerCode stub is 0x4f756172 ('Ouar'), which matches neither the release manufacturer code OuAu nor the dev code OuDv. This is a hand-written stub for compiling PluginProcessor.cpp in the headless console app, which never registers an AU/VST3 component, so the value has zero functional impact and does not block the gate. Note the sibling JucePlugin_PluginCode stub IS correct (0x4f536942 = 'OSiB').
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: For consistency with the project standard, update the JucePlugin_ManufacturerCode macro in the harness CMake to the OuAu/OuDv code (0x4f754175 / 0x4f754476) so the test stub mirrors the real plugin; purely cosmetic, defer freely as it affects no built artifact.

unified_issues.description: The preset-tour subtitle uses the CSS class '.tour-soon' (defined styles.css:446), a stale name carried over from the pre-Stage-4 'coming soon' state. The visible copy is fully updated and the styling renders correctly, so this is a non-visible naming artifact only — no user-facing impact.
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Rename the '.tour-soon' class to a state-neutral name such as '.tour-hint' in both index.html and styles.css to remove the stale 'coming soon' connotation; cosmetic cleanup, safe to defer.
